weekSubtitle: Die Farben (Colors), What You Like & Song Story

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Die Farben (12 Colors)
lessons.description: Meet Hallo! and learn all 12 German colors with paint splashes, Say-It guides, and English meanings.
lessons.hint: Look at the paint splash, say the German color out loud, and check the 'Say it' bubble!

cards.frontHint: German for 'Hello!' is Hallo! Ready to paint in German?
cards.explanation: Hallo! (Hello!) In this lesson, we learn 12 German color words: rot, gelb, grün, blau, weiß, orange, lila, grau, schwarz, rosa, braun, and bunt!
cards.example: Das ist bunt. Ich mag alle Farben!
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist boont. ikh mahk AH-luh FAHR-ben!
cards.exampleTranslation: That is colorful. I like all colors!
cards.tip: Tap the 🔊 speaker on any card to hear real German pronunciation first, then English!

cards.explanation: Rot means red — the color of strawberries, ladybugs, and firetrucks!
cards.example: Das ist rot. Ich mag rot.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist roht. ikh mahk roht.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is red. I like red.
cards.tip: Think of a red boat — rot rhymes with 'boat'!

cards.explanation: Gelb means yellow — bright like sunshine, lemons, and bananas!
cards.example: Das ist gelb. Ich mag gelb.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist gelp. ikh mahk gelp.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is yellow. I like yellow.
cards.tip: Use a hard 'g' like in 'go' (never 'j'). At the end, b sounds like a gentle 'p': gelp!

cards.explanation: Grün means green — the color of frogs, leaves, and crunchy green apples!
cards.example: Das ist grün. Ich mag grün.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist gruen. ikh mahk gruen.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is green. I like green.
cards.tip: See the two dots on ü? Make your lips round like saying 'oo', then try to say 'ee' inside!

cards.explanation: Blau means blue — the color of a sunny sky and the deep ocean!
cards.example: Das ist blau. Ich mag blau.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist blou. ikh mahk blou.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is blue. I like blue.
cards.tip: In German, 'au' always sounds like 'ow' in 'cow' — so blau sounds like 'blou'!

cards.explanation: Weiß means white — the color of puffy clouds, snow, and warm milk!
cards.example: Das ist weiß. Ich mag weiß.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist vice. ikh mahk vice.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is white. I like white.
cards.tip: Remember: w = 'v', ei = 'eye', and ß = sharp 's'. Put them together to say 'vice'!

cards.explanation: Orange means orange — spelled just like English, like pumpkins and carrots!
cards.example: Das ist orange. Ich mag orange.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist oh-RAHN-zhuh. ikh mahk oh-RAHN-zhuh.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is orange. I like orange.
cards.tip: Say the ending soft like 'zhuh' (just like the 's' in 'treasure')!

cards.explanation: Lila means purple — the color of juicy grapes and lilac flowers!
cards.example: Das ist lila. Ich mag lila.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist LEE-lah. ikh mahk LEE-lah.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is purple. I like purple.
cards.tip: Easy to say! Just think of a lilac flower and say 'LEE-lah'!

cards.explanation: Grau means grey — the color of rain clouds, koalas, and elephants!
cards.example: Das ist grau. Ich mag grau.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist grou. ikh mahk grou.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is grey. I like grey.
cards.tip: Just like blau ('blou'), 'au' sounds like 'ow' in 'cow' — so grau = 'grou'!

cards.explanation: Schwarz means black — the color of night skies and panthers!
cards.example: Das ist schwarz. Ich mag schwarz.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist shvahrts. ikh mahk shvahrts.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is black. I like black.
cards.tip: 3 German sound secrets: 'sch' = sh, 'w' = v, and 'z' = ts → shvahrts!

cards.explanation: Rosa means pink — the color of flamingos, cotton candy, and pink roses!
cards.example: Das ist rosa. Ich mag rosa.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist ROH-zah. ikh mahk ROH-zah.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is pink. I like pink.
cards.tip: The 's' in the middle buzzes gently like a 'z': ROH-zah!

cards.explanation: Braun means brown — the color of teddy bears, chocolate, and tree trunks!
cards.example: Das ist braun. Ich mag braun.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist broun. ikh mahk broun.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is brown. I like brown.
cards.tip: Sounds just like the English word 'brown', only spelled b-r-a-u-n!

cards.explanation: Bunt means colorful or multicolored — lots of bright colors all mixed together like a rainbow or painter's palette!
cards.example: Das ist bunt. Ich mag bunt.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist boont. ikh mahk boont.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is colorful. I like colorful things.
cards.tip: Say 'boont' (like 'moon' + 't')! You'll hear 'bunt' in the painter verse of our German song!

cards.explanation: Awesome! You learned rot (red), gelb (yellow), grün (green), blau (blue), weiß (white), orange, lila (purple), grau (grey), schwarz (black), rosa (pink), braun (brown), and bunt (colorful)!
cards.example: rot, gelb, grün, blau, weiß, orange, lila, grau, schwarz, rosa, braun, bunt!
cards.exampleTranscription: roht, gelp, gruen, blou, vice, oh-RAHN-zhuh, LEE-lah, grou, shvahrts, ROH-zah, broun, boont!
cards.exampleTranslation: red, yellow, green, blue, white, orange, purple, grey, black, pink, brown, colorful!
cards.tip: Next, tap 'Color Splash Pop!' to match every paint splash to its German word!

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Talking About Colors
lessons.description: Say 'That is...', 'I like...', ask 'Magst du...?', and answer with 'Ja!' or 'Nein.'
lessons.hint: Ich mag = I like. Magst du...? = Do you like...? Ja = Yes, Nein = No!

cards.explanation: We start with a friendly wave! Hallo means Hello in German.
cards.example: Hallo! Das ist rot.
cards.exampleTranscription: HAH-loh! dahs ist roht.
cards.exampleTranslation: Hello! That is red.
cards.tip: It sounds almost just like English 'Hello', with 'Hah' at the start!

cards.explanation: Point to any color and say 'Das ist ___!' — That is ___!
cards.example: Das ist blau. Das ist grün.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist blou. dahs ist gruen.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is blue. That is green.
cards.tip: Swap the last word for ANY color: Das ist lila! Das ist rosa!

cards.explanation: Say what you like in German using 'Ich mag ___.' ('I like ___').
cards.example: Ich mag orange. Ich mag lila.
cards.exampleTranscription: ikh mahk oh-RAHN-zhuh. ikh mahk LEE-lah.
cards.exampleTranslation: I like orange. I like purple.
cards.tip: In 'ich', make a soft whispering cat breath (not a hard 'k'). In 'mag', the 'g' sounds like 'k': mahk!

cards.explanation: Flip 'Ich mag' to 'Magst du ___?' when you want to ask a friend if they like a color!
cards.example: Magst du gelb?
cards.exampleTranscription: mahkst doo gelp?
cards.exampleTranslation: Do you like yellow?
cards.tip: Look how 'ich mag' (I like) changes to 'magst du' (do you like) when asking 'you'!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Happy yellow splash with smiley face

cards.explanation: From your slide: 'Magst du gelb?' 😊 'Ja!' — Yes, I like yellow!
cards.example: Magst du gelb? Ja!
cards.exampleTranscription: mahkst doo gelp? yah!
cards.exampleTranslation: Do you like yellow? Yes!
cards.tip: German 'J' always sounds like English 'Y' — so Ja sounds like 'yah'!

cards.explanation: From your slide: 'Magst du grau?' 😔 'Nein.' — No, I do not like grey.
cards.example: Magst du grau? Nein.
cards.exampleTranscription: mahkst doo grou? nine.
cards.exampleTranslation: Do you like grey? No.
cards.tip: Nein sounds just like the English number '9' (nine)! Never confuse it with English!

cards.transcription: dahs ist ... / ikh mahk ... / mahkst doo ...?
cards.explanation: Put all 3 patterns together: 1) Point: 'Das ist rot.' (That is red.) 2) Share: 'Ich mag rot.' (I like red.) 3) Ask: 'Magst du blau?' — 'Ja!' or 'Nein.'
cards.example: Das ist rosa. Ich mag rosa. Magst du braun? Nein.
cards.exampleTranscription: dahs ist ROH-zah. ikh mahk ROH-zah. mahkst doo broun? nine.
cards.exampleTranslation: That is pink. I like pink. Do you like brown? No.
cards.tip: Practice asking your mom, dad, or sibling: 'Magst du grün?'

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Song — Grün, grün, grün
lessons.description: Sing 'Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider' and match all 6 colors & jobs from your slides!
lessons.hint: Each verse pairs a color with a job: grün→Jäger, rot→Reiter, blau→Matrose, schwarz→Schornsteinfeger, weiß→Müller, bunt→Maler!

cards.frontTitle: Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider
cards.transcription: gruen, gruen, gruen zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der
cards.translation: Green, green, green are all my clothes
cards.frontHint: A famous German sing-along! Every color matches a special job!
cards.explanation: Every verse repeats the same cheerful tune with a new color and job! 'Kleider' (KLY-der) means clothes, 'alles, was ich hab' means everything I have, 'Darum lieb ich...' means That's why I love..., and 'mein Schatz' literally means 'my treasure' (someone special to me!).
cards.example: Darum lieb ich alles, was so bunt ist!
cards.exampleTranscription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les, vahs zoh boont ist!
cards.exampleTranslation: That is why I love everything that is so colorful!
cards.tip: Flip through all 6 song verses next — try tapping 🔊 to hear the German lines!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Green paint splash for the hunter (Jäger)

cards.explanation: Verse 1 pairs green clothes (grün) with a hunter / forest ranger (Jäger — 'YAY-ger') who blends into the green forest!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Jäger ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine YAY-ger ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a hunter.

songLines.german: Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider, grün, grün, grün ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: gruen, gruen, gruen zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, gruen ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: Green, green, green are all my clothes, green is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so grün ist, weil mein Schatz ein Jäger ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh gruen ist, vyle mine shahts ine YAY-ger ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so green, because someone special to me is a hunter.

cards.tip: J in German sounds like 'Y' — so Jäger is 'YAY-ger'!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Red paint splash for the rider (Reiter)

cards.explanation: Verse 2 pairs bright red clothes (rot) with a horseback rider (Reiter — 'RYE-ter') wearing a red riding jacket!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Reiter ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine RYE-ter ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a rider.

songLines.german: Rot, rot, rot sind alle meine Kleider, rot, rot, rot ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: roht, roht, roht zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, roht ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: Red, red, red are all my clothes, red is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so rot ist, weil mein Schatz ein Reiter ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh roht ist, vyle mine shahts ine RYE-ter ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so red, because someone special to me is a rider.

cards.tip: Think of English 'ride' + German 'ei' = 'eye' → Reiter (RYE-ter)!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Blue paint splash for the sailor (Matrose)

cards.explanation: Verse 3 pairs ocean blue clothes (blau) with a sailor (Matrose — 'mah-TROH-zuh') sailing across the blue sea!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Matrose ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine mah-TROH-zuh ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a sailor.

songLines.german: Blau, blau, blau sind alle meine Kleider, blau, blau, blau ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: blou, blou, blou zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, blou ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: Blue, blue, blue are all my clothes, blue is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so blau ist, weil mein Schatz ein Matrose ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh blou ist, vyle mine shahts ine mah-TROH-zuh ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so blue, because someone special to me is a sailor.

cards.tip: Easy connection: Blue sea (blau) ➔ Sailor on a boat (Matrose)!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Black paint splash for the chimney sweep (Schornsteinfeger)

cards.explanation: Verse 4 pairs black clothes (schwarz) with a chimney sweep (Schornsteinfeger — 'SHORN-shtine-fay-ger') who cleans dark chimneys and brings good luck!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Schornsteinfeger ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine SHORN-shtine-fay-ger ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a chimney sweep.

songLines.german: Schwarz, schwarz, schwarz sind alle meine Kleider, schwarz, schwarz, schwarz ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: shvahrts, shvahrts, shvahrts zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, shvahrts ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: Black, black, black are all my clothes, black is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so schwarz ist, weil mein Schatz ein Schornsteinfeger ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh shvahrts ist, vyle mine shahts ine SHORN-shtine-fay-ger ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so black, because someone special to me is a chimney sweep.

cards.tip: Break the giant word into 4 fun pieces: SHORN + shtine + fay + ger! 'Schornstein' = chimney, 'Feger' = sweeper!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: White paint splash for the miller (Müller)

cards.explanation: Verse 5 pairs white clothes (weiß) with a miller (Müller — 'MUE-ler') covered in soft white wheat flour!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Müller ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine MUE-ler ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a miller.

songLines.german: Weiß, weiß, weiß sind alle meine Kleider, weiß, weiß, weiß ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: vice, vice, vice zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, vice ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: White, white, white are all my clothes, white is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so weiß ist, weil mein Schatz ein Müller ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh vice ist, vyle mine shahts ine MUE-ler ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so white, because someone special to me is a miller.

cards.tip: Remember: white flour dusted all over the miller's apron = weiß & Müller!

colorVisual.ariaLabel: Colorful rainbow splash for the painter (Maler)

cards.explanation: Verse 6 pairs colorful paint-splashed clothes (bunt) with a painter (Maler — 'MAH-ler') holding a rainbow brush!
cards.example: Weil mein Schatz ein Maler ist.
cards.exampleTranscription: vyle mine shahts ine MAH-ler ist.
cards.exampleTranslation: Because someone special to me is a painter.

songLines.german: Bunt, bunt, bunt sind alle meine Kleider, bunt, bunt, bunt ist alles, was ich hab.
songLines.transcription: boont, boont, boont zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der, boont ist AH-les vahs ikh hahp.
songLines.english: Colorful are all my clothes, colorful is everything I have.

songLines.german: Darum lieb ich alles, was so bunt ist, weil mein Schatz ein Maler ist.
songLines.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les vahs zoh boont ist, vyle mine shahts ine MAH-ler ist.
songLines.english: That is why I love everything so colorful, because someone special to me is a painter.

cards.tip: Artists get paint splashes of every color on their smock — that's why Maler wears bunt!

cards.transcription: grün/Jäger • rot/Reiter • blau/Matrose • schwarz/Schornsteinfeger • weiß/Müller • bunt/Maler
cards.explanation: You know the whole song! Green = Hunter (Jäger), Red = Rider (Reiter), Blue = Sailor (Matrose), Black = Chimney Sweep (Schornsteinfeger), White = Miller (Müller), Colorful = Painter (Maler)!
cards.example: grün → Jäger, rot → Reiter, blau → Matrose, schwarz → Schornsteinfeger, weiß → Müller, bunt → Maler.
cards.exampleTranscription: gruen YAY-ger, roht RYE-ter, blou mah-TROH-zuh, shvahrts SHORN-shtine-fay-ger, vice MUE-ler, boont MAH-ler.
cards.exampleTranslation: green hunter, red rider, blue sailor, black chimney sweep, white miller, colorful painter.
cards.tip: Now play 'Song Color & Job Match!' to connect every color to its job!

options: That is brown. I like brown.
That is blue. I like blue.
That is black. I do not like black.
questions.answer: That is brown. I like brown.
questions.hint: Slide 13 shows these exact two sentences next to brown paint!
questions.explanation: Das ist braun. Ich mag braun. = That is brown. I like brown.

questions.instruction: How do you say 'I like purple' in German?
questions.hint: purple = lila (LEE-lah), and I like = Ich mag.
questions.explanation: Ich mag lila. (Say it: 'ikh mahk LEE-lah.') = I like purple.

questions.instruction: Mia asks: 'Magst du rosa?' Leo loves pink! What does Leo say?
questions.hint: Start with 'Ja' (Yes) + 'ich mag rosa!' (I like pink!).
questions.explanation: Ja, ich mag rosa! (Say it: 'yah, ikh mahk ROH-zah!') = Yes, I like pink!

questions.instruction: What does 'Das ist orange. Ich mag orange.' mean?
questions.text: Das ist orange. Ich mag orange.
questions.transcription: dahs ist oh-RAHN-zhuh. ikh mahk oh-RAHN-zhuh.
options: That is orange. I like orange.
That is yellow. I like green.
questions.answer: That is orange. I like orange.
questions.hint: Break it in two: 'Das ist orange' + 'Ich mag orange'!
questions.explanation: Das ist orange. Ich mag orange. = That is orange. I like orange.

questions.instruction: What does this song line mean in English?
questions.text: Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider.
questions.transcription: gruen, gruen, gruen zint AH-luh MY-nuh KLY-der.
options: Green, green, green are all my clothes.
Blue, blue, blue is everything I eat.
I like green paint on my shoes.
questions.answer: Green, green, green are all my clothes.
questions.hint: grün = green, alle meine Kleider = all my clothes!
questions.explanation: Grün, grün, grün sind alle meine Kleider. = Green, green, green are all my clothes.

questions.instruction: What does 'Darum lieb ich alles, was so rot ist' mean?
questions.text: Darum lieb ich alles, was so rot ist.
questions.transcription: dah-ROOM leep ikh AH-les, vahs zoh roht ist.
options: That is why I love everything that is so red.
That is red and I do not like it.
My special someone paints red houses.
All my red clothes are in the closet.
questions.answer: That is why I love everything that is so red.
questions.hint: 'lieb ich' = I love, 'alles' = everything, 'rot' = red!
questions.explanation: Darum lieb ich alles, was so rot ist. = That is why I love everything that is so red.
